limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

order_by.description: Sort observations. Plain keys: created_at, started_at, completed_at, status, recording_subject_email. JSONB keys: result_score (scorer), result_verdict (monitor), result_confidence, scanner_version. Prefix with `-` for descending; nullable keys sort nulls last either way.

session_id.description: Session recording id to return observations for.
